title: Allgemeinverfügungen erlassen – Einschränkungen im Bezirk Mitte

extraction.placeName: Ritz Carlton, Schloss Bellevue and Bundeskanzleramt areas
extraction.summaryEn: Police issued temporary general orders in Mitte restricting assemblies and carrying of weapons and knives around several sites during a state visit. The restrictions apply from 29 March 2026 to 30 March 2026.
